# Urna

> A vector database in one file, with citations that stay valid. A `.urna` file holds the chunks, the embeddings, the source spans, the indices and the search contract; a Rust runtime maps it into memory, checks its hashes and answers offline with exact cosine scores and a `urna://content_hash/chunk_id` citation for every hit. Python builds the file, Rust serves it.

The CLI is a Rust binary: `brew tap hoffresearch/urna && brew install urna`, `cargo install urna` or `npm install -g @urna/cli`, then `urna setup` once (the embedder payload and its Python env). The Python package is separate: `pip install "urna[embed]"` (Python 3.12+) installs the library, the potion table and a read-only `urna` command (`validate`, `inspect`, `stats`, `search`); it needs no `urna setup`. MIT license, Hoff Research. Site: https://urna.dev. Docs: https://docs.urna.dev. Source: https://github.com/hoffresearch/urna

## Docs

- [docs.urna.dev](https://docs.urna.dev): the documentation site, with install, quickstart, concepts, guides and the full CLI, build spec, Python and file format reference; its [llms.txt](https://docs.urna.dev/llms.txt) indexes every page
- [README](https://github.com/hoffresearch/urna/blob/main/README.md): what it is, install, the two terminal screens, quickstart, the Python and CLI surfaces, benchmarks
- [Usage](https://github.com/hoffresearch/urna/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md): every verb, `urna setup` and `urna tui`, presets, offline mode, citations, the model registry, declarative builds, the compression levers, every install channel and the maintainer checklist
- [Architecture](https://github.com/hoffresearch/urna/blob/main/docs/arc/ARC.toml): the single architecture reference, in TOML: narrative, contracts, the file inventory and the Mermaid map of the build and query flows
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/hoffresearch/urna/blob/main/docs/BENCH.md): Urna against usearch, hnswlib, sqlite-vec and LanceDB on the same rows, same machine
- [Changelog](https://github.com/hoffresearch/urna/blob/main/docs/CHANGELOG): every release, with the why and the measured numbers
- [Security](https://github.com/hoffresearch/urna/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): reporting, supported versions, hardening, the data-governance posture
- [Contributing](https://github.com/hoffresearch/urna/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md): the contribution flow, the gate, code style

## Code

- [Crates](https://github.com/hoffresearch/urna/tree/main/crates): urna-format (the frozen v1 container), urna-runtime (mmap, SIMD, exact, HNSW, BM25, graph and hybrid search with exact rerank), urna-cli (the `urna` binary, published as the crate `urna`), urna-python (the PyO3 bridge, shipped as the `urna` wheel)
- [python/forge](https://github.com/hoffresearch/urna/tree/main/python/forge): the offline embedders, the model registry, declarative builds, the media stage, the quality gate
- [Examples](https://github.com/hoffresearch/urna/tree/main/examples): quickstart (the five-verb loop on twelve CC0 paragraphs), FastAPI, Flask, Jupyter
- [Agents contract](https://github.com/hoffresearch/urna/blob/main/.contracts/.agents/AGENTS.md): the one instruction source for AI coding agents and contributors

## Optional

- [Demo datasets](https://github.com/hoffresearch/urna/blob/main/data/demo/Instructions.md): the frozen pt-BR regression corpus, its identity and limitations, and the external reproducible benchmark
- [fakenews-ptbr-urna-benchmark](https://github.com/brennercruvinel/fakenews-ptbr-urna-benchmark): 23,335 pt-BR fake-news documents from seven public datasets, 2,601 queries with relevance judgments, three embedders and three presets in `.urna` files, rebuildable from pinned sources; files on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/brennercruvinel/fakenews-ptbr-urna-benchmark)
- [mtg-urna-benchmark](https://github.com/brennercruvinel/mtg-urna-benchmark): 38,627 Magic card scans in single-file `.urna` containers, the media profiles and the image models compared; files on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/brennercruvinel/mtg-urna-benchmark)
- [urna.dev](https://urna.dev): the site
